name: Trump Bill Signing
look: Donald Trump sits at a desk in the Oval Office, gold curtains behind him, wearing a dark suit and blue striped tie. He holds up an open black folder with two blank white pages, his signature at the bottom right, while aides in suits stand behind.
use: The blank pages of the folder become a sign. People write or paste whatever official decree they want to announce, so it looks like the president proudly showing off a newly signed order.
slots: the decree or picture placed on the blank pages of the open folder
examples: Executive order: every meeting that could have been an email is now an email
New rule: socks must be sold in packs of three, just in case
describe: president holding up a signed document at his desk
man in suit shows open folder with blank pages and a signature
politician proudly displaying a signed paper in the oval office
holding up a blank executive order for the cameras
guy at a desk showing an open black folder with gold curtains behind
origin: A photo of Donald Trump showing off a signed executive order in the Oval Office during the first weeks of his presidency in 2017.
